content:
jana: opened a docs PR to tighten the private/VPC install flow and add an "offline" quickstart for kms-proxy + HSM. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1407 — please review the systemd drop-in, cert bundle step, and the unix-socket SDK snippets.

phil: skimmed, looks good. two quick asks: show both default PKCS#11 socket paths and an example setfacl for the kms user; call out that private keys may remain in HSM while certs are on-disk.

arun: added a tiny cert bundling bash snippet: `cat ca.pem int.pem client.pem > /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem && chown kms:kms /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem && chmod 640 /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem`. also added a note about mtls and how to load bundle in the proxy config.

phil: for systemd, prefer a drop-in file example instead of replacing the unit. small snippet to include: `/etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-local.conf` with `Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml` and restart=on-failure. add `journalctl -u kms-proxy -f` to troubleshooting.

jana: good. can you add a one-line python/pathlib example for unix socket endpoints? users trip up with slashes.

arun: added this snippet: `from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock')
client = KMSClient(endpoint=f'unix://{path.as_posix()}')` — plus a tls example: `endpoint='tls://kms.example:443'`.

docs-bot: lint: link-check OK, spelling: 1 warning ("priviledged" -> "privileged"), accessibility: SVG alt missing (no svg added). CI preview: https://deploy-preview-1407--docs.redwood.ai/private-vpc-quickstart

phil: lgtm with the ACL and drop-in. jana: merge when ready, I'll follow-up with an SELinux note if needed.

jana: merging in ~5m unless objections. thanks all :white_check_mark:
